name: rerequest_check
description:
Rerequest a selected check that has failed.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/deployments/{deploymentId}/checks/{checkId}/rerequest --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

deploymentId.description: The deployment to rerun the check for.
